cohort: The study included 6,235 VLBW singleton infants born at 24 to 31 weeks of gestation between 1995 and 2016, excluding those with specific maternal complications.
finding: Maternal APH was associated with increased odds for BPD only in extremely premature infants (24-27 weeks), but not with excess mortality or adverse neonatal neurological outcomes.
gest_age: 24 to 31 weeks of gestation (with a subgroup of extremely preterm at 24-27 weeks)
